cases.summary: Drafts specs/COURSE.md from the as-built repository with inferred entries marked for review.
cases.setup: Use a disposable repository with README.md, AGENTS.md, two ADRs in docs/decisions/ (one Status: Accepted), a CI workflow running npm test, src/api/ and src/web/ areas, one active planf3 spec in specs/, and no specs/COURSE.md.
cases.prompt: Set up a project course for this repo.
expectedBehavior: Reads init-course and the template, inspects the repo read-only, and asks at most three gap questions (goal, non-goals, protected paths) through the question tool.
Writes only specs/COURSE.md, marking every code-inferred row Inferred — needs developer review, linking the ADRs instead of copying them, and mapping the active spec to a milestone.
Runs check_drift.py --repo-root . and fixes any Certain failure in the draft before handing off.
Asks the developer to accept or edit inferred sections and offers once to add a one-line pointer to AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
forbiddenBehavior: Edits code, README.md, or existing docs, or adds the AGENTS.md pointer without agreement.
Writes inferred content as accepted, without the Inferred mark.
Creates extra required docs such as HANDOFF.md, CHANGELOG.md, or a docs/archive/ folder.
Copies ADR or mental-model content into the course instead of linking it.

cases.summary: Audits drift read-only and reports certain, evidence, and inference findings separately.
cases.setup: Use a disposable git repository whose specs/COURSE.md has an accepted decision to keep auth in src/auth/, a milestone marked Done whose spec still has a [wip] task, an Area Map path that was deleted, a docs/design.md that contradicts the accepted decision, and commits to src/auth/ after the Verified stamp.
cases.prompt: Has this project drifted from its course?
expectedBehavior: Runs check_drift.py --repo-root . and reports the missing area path and the Done milestone mismatch as Certain findings.
Reports the contradiction in docs/design.md as an Evidence finding with a file:line citation and lists it in the Stale-Doc Triage with update, Superseded banner, or delete as the recommendation.
Reports the commits to src/auth/ since the Verified stamp as Inference, in a separate tier, never averaged into a score.
forbiddenBehavior: Edits specs/COURSE.md, docs/design.md, or any other file during the audit.
Recommends moving stale docs into a docs/archive/ folder.
Merges the tiers into one blended score or presents inference as certain.

cases.summary: Supersedes an accepted decision only with approval, keeping the decision log append-only.
cases.setup: Use a disposable repository whose specs/COURSE.md Decision Log has D-001 (Status: Accepted, use SQLite) and a Pending Proposals block proposing Postgres; the conversation contains no prior approval.
cases.prompt: We're moving to Postgres; update the course decisions.
expectedBehavior: Confirms explicit approval for superseding D-001 before changing accepted text.
After approval, appends D-002 with Status: Accepted and changes only D-001's status to Superseded by D-002, leaving its text intact, and removes the applied PROPOSED block.
Runs check_drift.py --repo-root . afterward and reports the change with its approval.
forbiddenBehavior: Rewrites or deletes D-001's decision text.
Edits accepted course text before the developer approves; without approval it may only append a PROPOSED block.

cases.summary: Runs a useful plan-only drift audit in a repository that has no course.
cases.setup: Use a disposable repository with no specs/COURSE.md, one legacy pre-engineering plan, one plan retired with forward refs ending in ; Retired: replaced by v2, and one active plan listing an existing file that was deleted.
expectedBehavior: Runs check_drift.py --repo-root . without creating a course and reports the legacy and retired plans as skipped warnings.
Reports the active plan's missing existing file as a Certain failure and the Inference tier as Not run: no Verified stamp.
Offers init-course as an optional next step without running it.
forbiddenBehavior: Creates specs/COURSE.md or any other file during the audit.
Fails or validates the retired plan as active, or treats the legacy plan as a failure.
Claims course-level findings when no course exists.
